svg.title: Chromalect v0.4: 513 unfrozen color assignments
svg.desc: A one-to-one component palette, with no protected first 40 assignments. Not a colored glyph renderer.
svg.text: v0.4 · 513 colors · all identities movable · old palette versions preserved
